title: ID0418417-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / P8 170000839] ENGIE EME- Issue with HMI
description:
Reported issue: My colleague tested the payment terminal on-site. Upon selecting the "Pay by terminal" option from the HMI, the charger displayed “Please wait” with the usual spinning circle animation. However, the process didn’t progress, and the terminal remained unresponsive. The only temporary solution so far has been to reboot the charger. What’s concerning is that there are no error flags indicating that the terminal is disconnected. We only become aware of the issue when someone is on-site and confirms that the terminal is not functioning. As I have highlighted in other tickets, this issue appears to be affecting multiple SI chargeD chargers equipped with CCV terminals, and seems to be spreading. For that reason, I would really appreciate it if this issue could be treated as high priority.
